title: CNA is transforming its newsroom with AI
summary: In this Executive Function series from OpenAI, discover how CNA is transforming its newsroom with AI. Editor-in-Chief Walter Fernandez shares insights on AI adoption, culture, and the future of journalism.
body: In this Executive Function series from OpenAI, discover how CNA is transforming its newsroom with AI. Editor-in-Chief Walter Fernandez shares insights on AI adoption, culture, and the future of journalism.
summaryZh: CNA通过与OpenAI合作，在新闻编辑室中引入AI技术，旨在重塑新闻生产流程。通过总编辑Walter Fernandez的分享，展示了AI在提升新闻采编效率、优化内容分发及应对行业文化变革方面的实践经验，为媒体行业的数字化转型提供了参考。

aiReview.reasonZh: CNA的案例提供了传统媒体行业如何通过AI转型以适应数字化时代需求的实践参考。
